label: Opening removes narrow shapes
subgoals: Shrink each shape by d and drop those that collapse
Grow the survivors back by d
Total the area of the shapes that did not return

label: Narrow arms of one polygon
subgoals: Merge the drawn shapes into one polygon
Keep the parts that can hold a 2d by 2d square

label: Spacing by growing and AND
subgoals: Grow each shape by half the spacing rule
Compute the overlap of the grown shapes in x and in y
Multiply the overlaps to get the area of the AND
